description: The Node.js runtime each CLI archive ships, pinned by size and SHA-256. The glibc, macOS and Windows archives are the official builds from baseUrl, and linux-x64-musl the Node.js project's unofficial-builds (https://github.com/nodejs/unofficial-builds) from its own baseUrl, as nodejs.org publishes no musl build; their digests are from each release's SHASUMS256.txt. linux-arm64-musl takes its executable (imageExecutable) from the digest-pinned Node.js Alpine image the musl archives build in (build-musl-archive.mjs), and its file is the official source tarball, whose LICENSE the archive ships: the unofficial linux-arm64-musl build is a non-PIE executable that postject's LIEF cannot inject a single-executable blob into (it adds no PT_NOTE and truncates the dynamic segment, so the result crashes on start), while the image's build is position-independent. That executable links libstdc++ and libgcc dynamically, which install.sh already requires on Alpine. build-cli-archive.mjs refuses any other file.
